question: GQ-007
subject: an Italian book got through, and the fix was measured before it was written

the_miss.book: Viaggio al Surinam e nell' interno della Guiana
the_miss.why_it_passed: the title filter knew German and Latin. It did not know Italian.
the_miss.found_by: scoring the 105 newly landed books — 104 of 105 English

the_fix_was_measured_not_assumed.one_marker_rule: flags 3 of 1,100 candidates — and TWO are English
the_false_positives: Sylva sylvarum: or a naturall historie
The travels of Sig. Pietro della Valle — 'della' is part of an Italian NAME
the_fix_was_measured_not_assumed.two_marker_rule: flags exactly 1 of 1,100, the Italian book
the_fix_was_measured_not_assumed.so: the threshold was chosen from the data, not by analogy with the Latin rule

a_case_the_two_marker_latin_rule_already.title: Opera, historiam naturalem spectantia; or, gazophylacium. Containing several 1000 figures of birds...
a_case_the_two_marker_latin_rule_already.why_it_matters: Latin title, English content. A one-marker rule would have excluded a legitimate English natural-history book.

french_added_same_turn.book: Voyage à la Nouvelle Galles du Sud — 30.8% English hit rate
french_added_same_turn.why_it_passed: the filter knew German, Latin and Italian. Not French.

a_general_rule_i_rejected.rule: any romance accent in the title
a_general_rule_i_rejected.why_rejected: three are ENGLISH — "catalogue raisonné", "in search of La Pérouse". An accent alone is a false-positive machine.

the_measured_threshold.accent_plus_3: flags exactly the one French book

french_added_same_turn.verified: 3/3 — French caught, both English titles with French loanwords spared
